## 1) Run module-level AUB autopilot (select best)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
**Purpose:** sweeps module candidates in the registry, runs evals, then promotes the best-performing module config (per your selection criteria).

**Check after run:**
- A generated report/artifact folder (often under `baseline/reports/` or an `experiment_system/runs/` directory depending on your repo conventions).

## 2) Run system-level autopilot

```bash
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```

**Check after run:**
- A ranked table of candidates (mean/min metrics, and any constraint checks).

- If your tooling depends on a Python venv, activate it first (and confirm dependencies installed).
